Cada cuántos minutos se copia el texto d: How many minutes between copies of the episode text into the index. 0 = disabled.
Coseno mínimo para que un pasaje documen: Minimum cosine for a document passage to enter the recall. It depends on the embedding model; with nomic-embed-text, 0.66.
Dirección con la que se accede a la apli: Address used to reach the application; it is used to build the sign-in return URL (e.g. https://mimirsynth.example.com).
Address shown as the sender, e.g. mimirsynth@example.com.
Emails (separados por comas) que son adm: Emails (comma-separated) that are administrators when signing in.
Idioma de la interfaz y de los correos p: Language of the interface and emails for anyone who has not chosen their own in “My account”. Each person can change it.
Intentos cuando el modelo responde con l: Attempts when the model answers with a rate limit or a transient error.
Las subidas se envían por partes de este: Uploads are sent in parts of this size (maximum 64).
Los ficheros más grandes se rechazan al: Larger files are rejected when uploaded or when scanning folders.
Los reescaneos automáticos sin incidenci: Automatic rescans with no issues are noise (one every few minutes): they are deleted sooner.
Máximo de pasajes de documentos que acom: Maximum number of document passages that accompany the facts in each recall.
Necesario para enviar invitaciones y enl: Needed to send invitations and recovery links by email. Without it, links are copied from Administration.
Pasado este plazo el enlace deja de func: After this period the link stops working and another must be generated.
Pasado este plazo se borran los trabajos: After this period finished, failed and cancelled jobs are deleted.
Página de tu proveedor donde se gestiona: Page at your provider where password, passkeys and two-factor are managed; it is linked from “My account”.
Quien entre con contraseña deberá activa: Anyone signing in with a password must enable two-factor (authenticator app) before using the application. It does not affect those signing in through the identity provider, which applies its own rules.
STARTTLS (587), SSL/TLS (465) o ninguno: STARTTLS (587), SSL/TLS (465) or none (trusted networks only).
Se aplica al crear o cambiar contraseñas: Applied when creating or changing passwords.
Si tarda más, el recall responde sin doc: If it takes longer, the recall answers without documents.
Tiempo máximo de la búsqueda documental: Maximum time of the document search
Tiempo que una cuenta queda bloqueada tr: How long an account stays locked after too many failed attempts.
Tras este número de contraseñas incorrec: After this many consecutive wrong passwords the account is temporarily locked.
Un documento cuyo texto supere este tama: A document whose text exceeds this size is not indexed.
Vacío si el servidor no pide autenticaci: Empty if the server does not require authentication.
Validez de invitaciones y enlaces de rec: Validity of invitations and recovery links
